esql.query: from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where winlog.channel=="Security" and event.code=="4625" and winlog.event_data.LogonType=="3"

title: Failed network logon
triage_tips: One event is noise; count failures per source and account.
Likely benign: mistyped passwords or service accounts with old passwords.
Do not use old field names (proc_cmdline, src_ip, usr_name) from the old runbook.
what_it_is: Low-severity rule that fires on a single failed Windows logon (event 4625) of logon type 3 (network).
why_it_flags: Failed network logons can indicate password guessing (credential access, T1110), but one event is usually noise such as mistyped passwords.
